items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: He was a routineer too, wasn't he? ... He was a ham. He was a big ham too.

ctx.x: He was a routineer too, wasn't he? Hell. He was a routineer, yeah. He was a ham. He was a ham. He was a big ham too. Yeah, routineer too. Yeah, routineer too. That's routineer, sister. Most everything that came from around Ramport and Padilla, around in that neighborhood, that was mostly... Ham. We used to call him jambon in French, that mean ham. Jambon, huh? Jambon. Jambon.
You speak French too. A little bit. I don't remember, but I call him ham. Well, that's all the same. Yeah. Ham right on. You see?
Oh, down in the country, Sonny, you remember any guitars or banjos down that way?
